name: lending-magazine
prompt:
The library now lends magazines: items of Kind "magazine". A magazine may be kept 14 days, each late day costs 20 cents, a receipt shows it as "Magazine: " followed by its title, it is kept on the "periodicals" shelf, and its loans cannot be renewed. Import accepts magazines. Nothing changes for the other kinds.
